description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nantuko Vigilante, adding {C}{C}.
When Nantuko Vigilante dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nantuko Vigilante from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante's morph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Nantuko Vigilante triggers, targeting any artifact and/or enchantment.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Nantuko Vigilante triggers, destroying any number of artifacts and/or enchantments.
